verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has a dedicated pre-commit hooks docs page. It gives a concrete hook invocation (`trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail`) that fails the commit when secrets are found. It also covers global setup via `core.hooksPath`, Husky integration, bypass via `--no-verify`, and a server-side pre-receive option. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the pre-commit hook works reliably in practice.
